verdict.rationale: Lago's first-party docs describe a dedicated webhooks feature. It covers signed payloads (HMAC among signature options), automatic retries on non-2xx responses or network errors (3 attempts), and a log for inspecting and retrying generated events. Webhook event types are also treated as part of the versioned v1 API contract. missing for 10: explicit documentation of registering an endpoint and choosing specific event types, a catalogue of available webhook events, independent or hands-on corroboration.
